technical_features.labels_or_markings: no visible manufacturer markings or certification badges; valve has small circular label with indistinct text
technical_features.connection_type: threaded pipe connections, wall-mounted via brackets

salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Remove by disconnecting supply/return pipes using pipe wrench; ensure system is drained and depressurized. Lift radiator carefully to avoid damaging enamel coating. Inspect for internal corrosion via valve access if reuse is intended.

hazard_and_diagnostic_flags: Verify presence of lead-based paint on radiator surface prior to handling or sanding; test for lead if refurbishment is planned.
Inspect wall behind radiator for potential asbestos-containing insulation or mastic, especially near baseboard area where discoloration is visible.
